answers.question: (no station-specific open questions were listed for Næstved)
answers.answer: Two ways across: a tunnel by the station building (stairs, some with ramps, to all three platforms) and a footbridge north-west of it with lifts to platform 1 and perron 2 (OSM). DSB confirms stairs and elevator but not positions.

answers.question: Lift to perron 3 (tracks 4/5): OSM maps none; DSB gives no detail.
answers.answer: Lift n10827094300 serves perron 3 (spor 4/5) (The raw OSM extract has n10827094300 inside the 4;5 outline r11627433. Source is OSM only.)
